caseStudies.title: Direct Hospitality Booking & Yield Optimization Engine
caseStudies.tagline: Transitioning a 4-star luxury landmark from OTA dependency to high-margin direct reservations.
caseStudies.challenge: The Peninsula was losing 18-25% in commission fees to third-party travel aggregators (OTAs). Their legacy portal had high checkout abandonment (>65%) and sluggish mobile speeds exceeding 4.2 seconds.
caseStudies.solution: Architected a custom Jamstack direct-booking portal featuring 3D virtual room tours, multi-currency instant payment gateway, and high-intent Google Search & Performance Max campaigns targeting executive travelers.

caseStudies.title: Omnichannel Rebranding & High-Retention Social Growth
caseStudies.tagline: Unifying retail packaging systems with high-retention viral video storytelling and Meta ads scaling.
caseStudies.challenge: Fragmented seasonal visual collateral across 20+ national outlets caused brand dilution among younger affluent demographics, leading to plateaued organic engagement on social channels.
caseStudies.solution: Standardized luxury packaging and typography architecture while producing a viral short-form cinematic reel engine backed by Meta Advantage+ catalog dynamic retargeting.

caseStudies.title: Enterprise Corporate Hub & Tier-1 Press Outreach
caseStudies.tagline: Positioning a national conglomerate as an ESG and financial innovator with global authority.
caseStudies.challenge: Enterprise conglomerate stakeholders and institutional investors struggled to access clean disclosures, ESG reports, and verified leadership perspectives amidst shifting corporate media narratives.
caseStudies.solution: Engineered an investor relations portal with real-time stock ticker sync, combined with a targeted tier-1 press release distribution network and CEO executive thought-leadership op-eds.

caseStudies.title: Intent Scaling & 3D Experiential Exhibition Pavilion
caseStudies.tagline: Connecting high-intent Google Search customer funnels with an immersive 3D physical exhibition space.
caseStudies.challenge: Competitive seasonal footwear market required dominating digital intent keywords while simultaneously driving experiential foot traffic and dwell time at the National Trade Fair.
caseStudies.solution: Engineered high-ROI Google Search & Performance Max funnels linked to an award-winning photorealistic 3D modular exhibition pavilion featuring interactive digital size-recommender kiosks.

caseStudies.title: SaaS Product Onboarding & Visual Identity Architecture
caseStudies.tagline: Redesigning complex AI data visualization into a clean, investor-ready UI/UX and visual branding system.
caseStudies.challenge: High churn during the first 5 minutes of free trial signup due to visual information overload and a disjointed brand identity that failed to inspire enterprise trust.
caseStudies.solution: Executed a comprehensive visual identity reboot, vector design system, and an interactive product tour that reduced time-to-first-value from 12 minutes down to 90 seconds.

caseStudies.title: Rapid Sellout Campaign & Immersive Stage Activation
caseStudies.tagline: Executing an aggressive 3-week digital ticketing blitz and turnkey experiential festival grounds.
caseStudies.challenge: With only 21 days until showtime, 15,000 festival tickets remained to be sold with zero room for advertising budget leakage or on-site gate queues.
caseStudies.solution: Orchestrated a viral Instagram/TikTok countdown campaign paired with influencer amplification, real-time ticket inventory urgency banners, and on-site RFID wristband access portals.
metrics: Zero Queue Bottlenecks at Gate Cutover

caseStudies.title: Luxury Dining & VIP Private Event Acquisition
caseStudies.tagline: Capturing high-ticket corporate banquet and luxury dining bookings through hyper-local intent search.
caseStudies.challenge: Banquet halls and private dining spaces had seasonal low-utilization weekdays, losing lucrative corporate conference and wedding bookings to competing 5-star properties.
caseStudies.solution: Deployed laser-targeted Google Search and YouTube video funnels for corporate event planners and wedding coordinators, directing to a dedicated 1-click consultation planner.
